# Wayfinder runtime projection

## Destination

One concise Agent Workflow-owned runtime derived from the pinned upstream
method replaces the conflicting prepend-plus-upstream specification.

## Current state

The projection mechanism is selected and implementation is underway.

## Territory

- Runtime method — the concise agent-facing navigation guidance.
- State contract — detailed storage, concurrency, and settlement mechanics.
- Provider projection — derives the installed skill from the owned runtime.

The provider projection depends on the runtime method, while the runtime points
to the state contract instead of duplicating its mechanics.
